### Truth for Life - December 31, 2016
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-december-31-2016.html
Passage: Jeremiah 8:20
Points:
- Jeremiah's lament highlights the tragedy of watching opportune seasons pass by while remaining spiritually unsaved.
- Many people regularly hear the gospel yet repeatedly procrastinate, hardening their hearts against God's mercy.
- Time moves swiftly from youth toward death, making continued delay increasingly perilous for the soul.
- Readers are earnestly urged to repent and trust in Jesus today rather than ending another year unforgiven.

### What Is the Balm of Gilead according to the Bible?
Author: Tammy Kennington
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-is-the-balm-of-gilead-according-to-the-bible.html
Passage: Jeremiah 8:22
Points:
- Jeremiah uses Gilead's renowned medicinal ointment as a picture of Israel's deep need for spiritual healing.
- The Lord provided spiritual leaders and stood ready to restore His people, but they persisted in pursuing idols.
- In scripture, the rare balm obtained by piercing the balsam plant foreshadows Jesus, the Great Physician.
- Believers are encouraged to bring their sin and emotional wounds to Christ, who was pierced on the cross for our healing.
